name: Dungeon Joe
tagline: A souls-like dungeon crawl: arena rooms, loot, bonfires and bosses
goal: Get as deep as you can in 15 minutes. Dying sends you back to the bonfire.
scoring: Everything × the zone it happens in: 10 a kill, 50 an Elite or Mimic, 100 a room cleared (each room once), 1,000 a Boss Rush Hour challenger, 3,000 the zone's boss, 2,000 for reaching a new zone. Dying costs only time.

modifiers.name: Glass Joe
modifiers.text: 1 max HP and every stat at 999. Joe hits like a truck and breaks like a teacup.

modifiers.name: Double Espresso
modifiers.text: The whole dungeon runs at double speed. So does Joe.

modifiers.name: Mimic Mania
modifiers.text: Every chest is a Mimic, and every fight room has one. Hit a chest before you open it.

modifiers.name: Elite Squad
modifiers.text: Every enemy is an Elite (swarms aside): triple HP, harder hits, a nasty affix, triple Shards.

modifiers.name: Paper Horde
modifiers.text: Enemies have 1 HP, but three times as many of them come.

modifiers.name: Bottomless Thermos
modifiers.text: The Thermos never runs dry. Drink as often as you dare.

modifiers.name: Dry Spell
modifiers.text: No Thermos at all. Bonfires still heal.

modifiers.name: Seeing Red
modifiers.text: Every enemy attack is Red: no blocking, no parrying. Dodge or get out of the way.

modifiers.name: Piñata Party
modifiers.text: Every enemy drops an item when it dies.

modifiers.name: Tiny Joe
modifiers.text: Joe shrank in the wash: half the size, a tiny hitbox, quicker feet, short arms and 40% less HP.

modifiers.name: Huge Joe
modifiers.text: Joe is enormous: twice the HP, long reach, 25% harder hits, slow feet and impossible to miss.

modifiers.name: Wrong Bag
modifiers.text: Joe grabbed the wrong bag: a random Legendary weapon from the whole armoury, and the stats to swing it.

modifiers.name: Spells Only
modifiers.text: No weapons today: a staff, a talisman, six spells and half the cooldowns.

modifiers.name: Boss Rush Hour
modifiers.text: Every third fight is a boss from another zone, waiting in its second phase.

modifiers.name: Eviction Notice
modifiers.text: One life. Die once and the run is over.

modifiers.name: Lights Out
modifiers.text: The fuse blew. You see only what Joe's lantern reaches.
